note: Behavior evals: dry-run (what the agent WOULD do, no execution), graded by an independent judge that sees only the transcript + assertions. live_acceptance are executed for real (plan Tasks 8-9).

evals.name: size gate fires before any read
evals.prompt: разбери scratchpad/fixture.log (~60МБ): найди все критические аномалии и собери таймлайн подозрительной сессии
assertions: FIRST action is a size probe (ls -la / wc -l), not Read.
No wholesale Read of the file; content samples limited to head/tail probes (<=50 lines total).
Plan cuts chunks on record boundaries into the scratchpad via Bash, then fans out agents per chunk group via Workflow pipeline().
Each sub-agent prompt contains ONLY its chunk paths + a narrow question; returns via schema, not prose.
Coverage is reported (chunks processed); any truncation is logged, not silent.

evals.name: under threshold -> skill stands down
evals.prompt: разбери logs/deploy.log — файл на 180 строк, что пошло не так при последнем деплое?
assertions: Agent checks size, sees it is under threshold, and reads the file normally.
No Workflow / chunking machinery is proposed for a 180-line file.

evals.name: needle ask -> coarse grep pass before fan-out
evals.prompt: в огромном логе payments.log (2 млн строк) найди все упоминания txn=TXN-4444 и объясни, что с этой транзакцией происходило
assertions: Agent runs grep -n for the anchor BEFORE any chunk fan-out.
If matches + context fit comfortably, agent extracts just those regions and answers without Workflow — and says so.
Fan-out is reserved for the case where candidates remain too large.

evals.name: recurse expressed as loop, not nested workflow
evals.prompt: map-фаза по 120 чанкам вернула 4000 находок суммарно на ~400КБ JSON — что дальше?
assertions: Aggregate is reduced in-script via a loop-until-small (batched reduce agents), NOT by nesting workflow() calls.
Budget remaining is consulted as a stop condition when a budget is set.
Early stop is logged with what was left unreduced.

evals.name: requirements-mining facts carry evidence paths
evals.prompt: перед оформлением фичи собери из репозитория факты: что уже работает в резолве бренда и не должно быть тронуто?
assertions: Output facts are of shape {claim, evidence_path, confidence} — every claim carries a concrete file path.
A claim without a path is demoted to a [факт: <вопрос>] placeholder, never presented as a fact.
Verified claims get a verify pass (an agent re-opens the path and confirms the quote supports the claim).

evals.name: Workflow unavailable -> plain-Agent fallback keeps the discipline
evals.prompt: Workflow-тул в этой сессии недоступен, а лог на 90МБ разобрать надо. Как действуешь?
assertions: Fallback is parallel plain Agent calls (fresh, not fork), one per chunk group, same chunk+narrow-question isolation.
The size gate and index-don't-ingest discipline are unchanged.
Agent notes the loss of pipeline()/budget conveniences without abandoning decomposition.

live_acceptance.name: giant-file end-to-end on seeded fixture
live_acceptance.question: найди все критические аномалии и собери таймлайн подозрительной сессии
criteria: All 12 seeded needles found: 4 PANIC ledger-drift lines, the 5-step sess-77f3a9 story in correct order, 3 UNSAFE_DIRECT_WRITE config overrides.
The fixture file is never read wholesale (no Read of the full file; probes <=50 lines).

live_acceptance.name: requirements-mining on the real my_architect repo
live_acceptance.question: собери факты для гейта по фиче Open Question & Dependency Gate: что уже работает и не должно быть тронуто?
criteria: Every fact carries an evidence_path into the repo; spot-check of 5 paths confirms the claims.
No invented facts; gaps surface as [факт: …] placeholders.
